profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary: Full stack software engineer with experience in a wide variety of languages and tech stacks.  I consider ruby as my primary language but also have worked in Python, Typescript building React Frontend applications, php, and Java.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Ruby on Rails · React.js · JavaScript

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led the Authentication (Auth) team in engineering a sophisticated authorization framework, leveraging Okta for initial authentication and crafting a proprietary system for role hierarchies and authorization logic to ensure users could only retrieve their own records.

Built a custom query engine in rails that supported a reusable list view component in react that I also wrote. Almost all teams across the app used this list view and built their various pages off of it.

Mentored junior engineers on things like json-api, ruby, rails, a graphQL like framework called graffiti. I helped them use Test-Driven Development, taught them how to read the rails source code, and how to debug and iteratively build complicated rails models.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Played a key role in enhancing the backend Ruby on Rails application designed as a modernization
API, seamlessly connecting disparate databases. Worked on this greenfield application, positioned as the centerpiece in transitioning from the legacy system slated for deprecation. Implemented JSON API functionality using Graphiti.

Build optimization engines python that would consolidate orders onto trucks with a complex set of rules. I also owned and built frameworks to perform extensive data analysis on the performance of
our engine using historical data.

positions.title: Software Engineer Part Time
positions.description:
Connected the current application to a hospitals who shared their radiology data with the company. The
company’s NLP engine would parse reports from doctors and place data into a queue

Contributed to the backend API where data was picked up by Celery workers and a Django/Python API
supported the react frontend where customers could login to view radiology follow up appointments
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Django · Celery · Ansible · Mirth

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Owned the Java Spring Boot SOAP service that handled the post checkout management process for customers purchasing insurance online

projects.title: Simple Recommendation Engine
projects.description: A simple movie recommendation engine with a github pipeline that packages modules and deploys them to AWS. Includes terraform for setting up S3 and AWS glue job.
